verdict.rationale: Loops supports event-triggered workflows (POST /events/send triggers workflows) and lifecycle automations (onboarding, activation, upgrade, winback emails) that are 'set up once' and run autonomously over time, which is the core of background automation for an email/lifecycle platform. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of workflow logic (branching, delays, conditions), and independent/hands-on corroboration that these automations reliably run unattended long-term.
